title: Theoretical, being confined to certain grammatical rules of accidence and syntax
html_source: In stark contrast to most dabblers in unfamiliar languages, Stephen and Bloom have more knowledge of the relevant languages rules than vocabulary. In other words, they could each construct a correct sentence in the other language, but lack the words to do so.
